Mira (Sales): Hey team — SentryBridge POC kickoff. They need SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, RBAC mappings, and domain controls. High level asks from the customer: 1) SAML IdP metadata + attribute mapping, 2) SCIM bulk/jit provisioning and rate limits, 3) ability to lock tenant to verified domain(s), 4) mapping IdP groups to Redwood roles, 5) whether Dedicated capacity needed for compliance, and 6) answers for the security questionnaire. Can SE/security help assemble preflight checklist and quick pricing estimate? (cc @Jane)
Alex (SE): I can own SAML/SCIM config and RBAC mapping doc. Quick Qs: what are their expected monthly MAUs and provisioning churn? SCIM rate limits change recommendation depends on provisioning bursts. Any idea on number of groups to map?
Jane (AE): They're expecting ~25k MAUs and ~4000 new users during onboarding month. Groups ~25, mostly role-based. They're asking about cost for a 3-month POC with ~200k tokens/day and SCIM provisioning spikes. Also flagged data residency + contractual SLA questions.
Alex (SE): For SAML attributes recommend: `nameid` (email), `givenName`, `familyName`, `groups` (array). Example mapping: IdP group `sentrybridge-admins` -> Redwood role `org_admin`; `sentrybridge-dev` -> `engineer`. For SCIM, our default throttle is 600 req/min/tenant; can raise for POC if we enable burst token on Dedicated. Example curl for metadata upload:
```
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/tokens --header "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d @saml-metadata.xml
```
Oliver (Security): On the questionnaire: we'll need to confirm encryption at rest (AES-256), KMS integration, audit log retention (90 days standard, can extend), pen test reports, SOC2 in flight. For domain controls: we support domain verification via DNS TXT records + enterprise proof-of-ownership flow — we can lock signups to verified domains and enable domain-scoped tenant isolation for Dedicated.
Mira (Sales): Legal also asked about SCIM user data retention and whether SCIM tokens are revocable per tenant — can we confirm?
Oliver (Security): Yes, SCIM tokens are revocable; we log token revocations. Retention is configurable per contract; default is 90 days for soft logs, 365 days for audit logs if enabled. We'll prepare a short Q/A blob for the security questionnaire.
Alex (SE): Regarding RBAC: suggest shipping a starter mapping JSON for the POC with 4 roles (owner, admin, developer, read-only). We'll include a small transform script to map IdP group names to Redwood role IDs. Example transform: `groups.map(g => groupMap[g] || 'reader')`.
Jane (AE): Pricing — for a 3-month POC with Dedicated burst (2x baseline) + support, ballpark $35k. If they stay hosted with standard plan, estimate $8k/mo for the token usage + SCIM spikes. I'll draft official quote after SE confirms capacity needs.
DeployBot: Deployment succeeded: `poc/sentrybridge` deployed to staging at 3255550060 by alex_se — image v2026-02-14-rc3
Alex (SE): I'll attach the SAML metadata template and a sample SCIM rate-lift request we'll send to infra. Also will produce minimal runbook for tenant domain lock + rollback steps.
Mira (Sales): Great — can we aim to send the security Q&A + SAML template + pricing by EOD tomorrow? I'll sync with the customer's IT lead. :thumbsup:
Oliver (Security): I'll own the security Q&A draft and attach SOC2 scope doc. Expect a draft in 24h.
Jane (AE): I'll prepare the preliminary quote and payment terms and loop legal if they need NDA addenda.
Alex (SE): I'll run a dry-run provisioning against staging tomorrow and post logs here. Need a list of 3 sample users from customer to test group mapping.
Mira (Sales): I'll request the test users and ask for SAML metadata. Thanks team :)
